name.value: Doug Mitchell Thunderbird Winter Sports Centre

description.value: The Doug Mitchell Thunderbird Winter Sports Centre is UBC Vancouver's primary ice arena, hosting drop-in hockey, skating, and the Thunderbird Adult Hockey League on campus. Named after philanthropist Doug Mitchell, it is part of UBC Recreation's broader sports complex and serves students, faculty, and the general public. A touring cyclist visiting the UBC area will find it situated near the heart of the campus alongside other recreation facilities.
